g.text: The CU's connector is the DRC 64 with a DTP comfort inlet, the seats' heat and cool are its + side switches, the radar receiver is inside it, the face is the eighth pass, the CUR is on four I2C wires.

svg.text: Control Unit, mock-up: top (from above, the face down), 188.0 x 217.6 mm.
Provisional, nothing measured. Carrier as stand-in blocks; blue = room kept clear.
